About the factory

Built on German press technology, run from one factory floor.

Maruti Paver Industries casts concrete pavers, kerbstones, solid blocks and bricks from a single facility in Chetawala, Rajasthan.

The line runs on German-built hydraulic press and vibration-compaction machinery, which holds pressure and cycle time steady across a run — the difference between a paver that chips at the edge in a season and one that doesn't. The same quality-controlled mix feeds all four product lines.

Hydraulic pressing Vibration compaction Batch-controlled mix Custom mould sizes
Clean-cut edge, every batch

The difference

Every block is pressed, not poured.

Hand-cast concrete finds its own density. A German hydraulic press doesn't — which is why two pavers from the same run measure the same, hold the same edge, and wear the same way.

Technology

How each block is made.

Every unit is pressed and vibrated to density on German block-making machinery, then cured before it leaves the yard.

1

Batching & mixing

Aggregate, cement and additives are measured to a fixed ratio for the product line being run.

2

Pressing & compaction

The German-engineered press applies controlled pressure and vibration, driving out air pockets for a repeatable density.

3

Curing

Freshly pressed units cure under controlled conditions until they reach handling strength.

4

Quality check

Cured units are checked for dimension, edge and finish before dispatch to site.

The hydraulic press class behind every batch

Quantity & delivery planning
